messages:
emma: FYI i started bringup for r3b-compact-int8 on the web-sampled rerank harness and numbers look noisy. ndcg@10 down ~4.5% vs prod baseline, mrr slightly up.
raj: can you attach a couple of concrete query+candidate examples so we can eyeball?
emma: pasted two quick ones below — note raw urls and weird title-casing in candidates.
```
Q: how do i reset my password
cand A: "To reset, visit https://support.example.com/reset and follow the steps."
cand B: "To Reset Password: Settings → Account → Reset"
```
sam: ok prod pipeline canonicalizes (lowercase, strip simple urls). what pipeline did you run? raw or canonicalized eval?
emma: ran eval-harness v2 default which uses raw text. i re-ran a tiny sample with textnorm_v1 (lowercase + strip urls) and ndcg improves a lot.
tess: share the numbers w/rounding pls. we need to know how much formatting vs quant matters.
emma: baseline(prod): ndcg@10=0.412, mrr=0.276. r3b-int8 raw: ndcg@10=0.394, mrr=0.281. r3b-int8 canonicalized: ndcg@10=0.408, mrr=0.279.
raj: so majority regression is formatting mismatch. there's still ~0.004 ndcg gap. could be truncation, kvpack int8 artifacts, or candidate sorting differences.
emma: i'm kicking a CI run to isolate those factors. job: rerank-ci/r3b-int8-canonicalization-ablation. flags: --canonicalizer=textnorm_v1 --force-sort=prod-order --report=ndcg,mrr,delta. @ci-bot can you queue it on the short executor and add --seqlen-hist?
ci-bot: Job rerank-ci/r3b-int8-canonicalization-ablation queued (executor: short). details: https://ci.internal/rerank/1765432109. added --seqlen-hist as requested.
sam: also log per-query candidate diffs for top-3 ranking swaps. embed/token shifts caused by urls can change scores even if textnorm helps.
tess: note that kvpack truncation sometimes causes long doc scoring skew on int8; add a truncation-ablation toggle to the job (--kvpack-off / --kvpack-on).
emma: added both toggles and candidate-diff logging. plan: 1) confirm canonicalizer parity (this run), 2) ablate kvpack/truncation, 3) if gap persists, scatterplot fp16 vs int8 candidate scores and sample anomalies.
raj: assign sam to diff logging + scatter, tess to seqlen/kvpack ablation, emma to run CI and compile a short triage note. i'll draft a quick postmortem if we confirm formatting mismatch as primary cause. :thumbsup:
